# Invoice field extractor

*Client industry: fintech | Completed: 2024-01-30 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p01*

## The problem
The client was an accounts team keying invoice totals by hand.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenCV, a typed async Python web API. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project reached 96% field-level accuracy on 2,000 held-out invoices.
